recognize_zh: MUM1 染色中一群較大的細胞核呈強弱不一的棕色核染色，散在於陰性的小造血細胞之間，另有少數強陽性的漿細胞；大型腫瘤細胞 MUM1 陽性表示非生發中心（activated B-cell）表現型，這是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤常見的表型。
features: Nuclear MUM1/IRF4 staining of variable intensity in a population of large cells
Positive large nuclei oval with vesicular chromatin, some with cytoplasmic blush
Few small cells with very strong nuclear staining (likely plasma cells)
Small hematopoietic cells in the background negative
Positive cells scattered and loosely clustered near fat spaces/sinusoids
describe_en: MUM1/IRF4 immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy shows nuclear staining of variable intensity in scattered and loosely clustered large cells, several located along vascular spaces adjacent to fat. A few smaller cells with intense nuclear staining likely represent plasma cells, and the background hematopoietic cells are negative. MUM1 expression in the large atypical cells indicates a non-germinal center (activated B-cell) phenotype, which is typical of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma. Findings support the diagnosis in conjunction with CD20 and the intrasinusoidal distribution.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are small to medium with eccentric nuclei and uniformly strong MUM1 and CD138, and are not CD20-positive large cells within sinusoids.
Neoplastic plasma cells are MUM1 and CD138 positive but CD20 negative, with light chain restriction and interstitial or sheet-like distribution.
GCB-type lymphoma typically is CD10/BCL6 positive and MUM1 negative.
